verses.text_uthmani: أَتَىٰٓ أَمْرُ ٱللَّهِ فَلَا تَسْتَعْجِلُوهُ ۚ سُبْحَـٰنَهُۥ وَتَعَـٰلَىٰ عَمَّا يُشْرِكُونَ

translations.text: God’s Judgement is coming, so do not ask to bring it on sooner. Glory be to Him! He is far above anything they join with Him!
Aagaya Allah ka faisla, ab iske liye jaldi na machao, paak hai woh aur baala-tar hai us shirk se jo yeh log kar rahey hain

verses.text_uthmani: يُنَزِّلُ ٱلْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةَ بِٱلرُّوحِ مِنْ أَمْرِهِۦ عَلَىٰ مَن يَشَآءُ مِنْ عِبَادِهِۦٓ أَنْ أَنذِرُوٓا۟ أَنَّهُۥ لَآ إِلَـٰهَ إِلَّآ أَنَا۠ فَٱتَّقُونِ

translations.text: He sends down angels with inspiration at His command, to whichever of His servants He chooses, to give [His] warning: ‘There is no god but Me, so beware of Me.’

Woh is rooh ko apne jis banday par chahta hai apne hukum se malaika ke zariye nazil farma deta hai (is hidayat ke saath ke logon ko) “aagah kardo, mere siwa koi tumhara mabood nahin hai, lihaza tum mujhi se daro”

verses.text_uthmani: خَلَقَ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ بِٱلْحَقِّ ۚ تَعَـٰلَىٰ عَمَّا يُشْرِكُونَ

translations.text: He created the heavens and earth for a true purpose, and He is far above whatever they join with Him!
Usne aasman o zameen ko barhaqq paida kiya hai, woh bahut baala o bartar hai us shirk se jo yeh log karte hain

verses.text_uthmani: خَلَقَ ٱلْإِنسَـٰنَ مِن نُّطْفَةٍ فَإِذَا هُوَ خَصِيمٌ مُّبِينٌ

translations.text: He created man from a drop of fluid, and yet man openly challenges Him.
Usne Insaan ko ek zara si boondh se paida kiya aur dekhte dekhte sareehan woh ek jhagdalu hasti ban gaya

verses.text_uthmani: وَٱلْأَنْعَـٰمَ خَلَقَهَا ۗ لَكُمْ فِيهَا دِفْءٌ وَمَنَـٰفِعُ وَمِنْهَا تَأْكُلُونَ

translations.text: And livestock––He created them too. You derive warmth and other benefits from them: you get food from them;
Usne jaanwar paida kiye jinmein tumhare liye poshak (clothing) bhi hai aur khurak bhi, aur tarah tarah ke dusre faiyde bhi

verses.text_uthmani: وَلَكُمْ فِيهَا جَمَالٌ حِينَ تُرِيحُونَ وَحِينَ تَسْرَحُونَ

translations.text: you find beauty in them when you bring them home to rest and when you drive them out to pasture.
Unmein tumhare liye jamal (pleasant look) hai jab ke subah tum unhein charne ke liye bhejte ho aur jabke shaam unhein wapas latey ho

verses.text_uthmani: وَتَحْمِلُ أَثْقَالَكُمْ إِلَىٰ بَلَدٍ لَّمْ تَكُونُوا۟ بَـٰلِغِيهِ إِلَّا بِشِقِّ ٱلْأَنفُسِ ۚ إِنَّ رَبَّكُمْ لَرَءُوفٌ رَّحِيمٌ

translations.text: They carry your loads to lands you yourselves could not reach without great hardship––truly your Lord is kind and merciful––

Woh tumhare liye bojh dho (utha) kar aisey aisey muqaam tak le jatey hain jahan tum sakht jaanfishani (painful toil) ke bagair nahin pahunch sakte. Haqeeqat yeh hai ke tumhara Rubb bada hi shafeeq aur meharbaan hai

verses.text_uthmani: وَٱلْخَيْلَ وَٱلْبِغَالَ وَٱلْحَمِيرَ لِتَرْكَبُوهَا وَزِينَةً ۚ وَيَخْلُقُ مَا لَا تَعْلَمُونَ

translations.text: horses, mules, and donkeys for you to ride and use for show, and other things you know nothing about.

Usne ghodey (horses) aur khacchar (mule) aur gadhey paida kiya taa-ke tum unpar sawar ho aur woh tumhari zindagi ki raunak baney. Woh aur bhaut si cheezein (tumhare faiyde ke liye) paida karta hai jinka tumhein ilm tak nahin hai

verses.text_uthmani: وَعَلَى ٱللَّهِ قَصْدُ ٱلسَّبِيلِ وَمِنْهَا جَآئِرٌ ۚ وَلَوْ شَآءَ لَهَدَىٰكُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ

translations.text: God points out the right path, for some paths lead the wrong way: if He wished, He could guide you all.
Aur Allah hi ke zimme hai seedha raasta batana jabke raaste tedhey bhi maujood hain. Agar woh chahta to tum sabko hidayat de deta

verses.text_uthmani: هُوَ ٱلَّذِىٓ أَنزَلَ مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَآءً ۖ لَّكُم مِّنْهُ شَرَابٌ وَمِنْهُ شَجَرٌ فِيهِ تُسِيمُونَ

translations.text: It is He who sends down water for you from the sky, from which comes a drink for you, and the shrubs that you feed to your animals.
Wahi hai jisne aasman se tumhare liye pani barsaya jissey tum khud bhi sairaab hotey ho aur tumahre jaanwaron ke liye bhi chara paida hota hai

verses.text_uthmani: يُنۢبِتُ لَكُم بِهِ ٱلزَّرْعَ وَٱلزَّيْتُونَ وَٱلنَّخِيلَ وَٱلْأَعْنَـٰبَ وَمِن كُلِّ ٱلثَّمَرَٰتِ ۗ إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَةً لِّقَوْمٍ يَتَفَكَّرُونَ

translations.text: With it He grows for you grain, olives, palms, vines, and all kinds of other crops. There truly is a sign in this for those who reflect.
Woh is pani ke zariye se khetiyan ugata hai aur zaitun aur khajoor aur angoor aur tarah tarah ke dusre phal paida karta hai. Is mein ek badi nishani hai un logon ke liye jo gaur-o-fikr karte hain

verses.text_uthmani: وَسَخَّرَ لَكُمُ ٱلَّيْلَ وَٱلنَّهَارَ وَٱلشَّمْسَ وَٱلْقَمَرَ ۖ وَٱلنُّجُومُ مُسَخَّرَٰتٌۢ بِأَمْرِهِۦٓ ۗ إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَـٰتٍ لِّقَوْمٍ يَعْقِلُونَ

translations.text: By His command He has made the night and day, the sun, moon, and stars all of benefit to you. There truly are signs in this for those who use their reason.

Usne tumhari bhalayi ke liye raat aur din ko aur Suraj aur Chand ko musakkhar kar rakkha hai, aur sab taare (stars) bhi usi ke hukum se musakkhar hain. Ismein bahut si nihsaniyan hain un logon ke liye jo aqal se kaam letey hain

verses.text_uthmani: وَمَا ذَرَأَ لَكُمْ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ مُخْتَلِفًا أَلْوَٰنُهُۥٓ ۗ إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَةً لِّقَوْمٍ يَذَّكَّرُونَ

translations.text: He has made of benefit to you the many-coloured things He has multiplied on the earth. There truly are signs in this for those who take it to heart.
Aur yeh jo bahut si rang bi rang ki cheezein usne tumhare liye zameen mein se paida kar rakkhi hai, in mein bhi zaroor nishani hai un logon ke liye jo sabaq haasil karne waley hain

verses.text_uthmani: وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِى سَخَّرَ ٱلْبَحْرَ لِتَأْكُلُوا۟ مِنْهُ لَحْمًا طَرِيًّا وَتَسْتَخْرِجُوا۟ مِنْهُ حِلْيَةً تَلْبَسُونَهَا وَتَرَى ٱلْفُلْكَ مَوَاخِرَ فِيهِ وَلِتَبْتَغُوا۟ مِن فَضْلِهِۦ وَلَعَلَّكُمْ تَشْكُرُونَ

translations.text: It is He who made the sea of benefit to you: you eat fresh fish from it and bring out jewellery to wear; you see the ships cutting through its waves so that you may go in search of His bounty and give thanks.

Wahi hai jisne tumhare liye samandar ko musakkhar kar rakkha hai taa-ke tum ussey tarr-o-taaza gosht lekar khao aur ussey zeenat (adornment) ki woh cheezein nikalo jinhein tum pehna karte ho. Tum dekhte ho ke kashti samandar ka seena cheerti hui chalti hai, yeh sab kuch is liye hai ke tum apne Rubb ka fazal talash karo aur uske shukar-guzar bano

verses.text_uthmani: وَأَلْقَىٰ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ رَوَٰسِىَ أَن تَمِيدَ بِكُمْ وَأَنْهَـٰرًا وَسُبُلًا لَّعَلَّكُمْ تَهْتَدُونَ

translations.text: He has made mountains stand firm on the earth, to prevent it shaking under you, and rivers and paths so that you may find your way,
Usne zameen mein pahadon ki mekhein gaadh di taa-ke zameen tumko lekar dhulak na jaye, usne dariya jari kiya aur qudrati raaste banaye taa-ke tum hidayat pao

verses.text_uthmani: وَعَلَـٰمَـٰتٍ ۚ وَبِٱلنَّجْمِ هُمْ يَهْتَدُونَ

translations.text: and landmarks and stars to guide people.
Usne zameen mein raasta batane wali alamatein rakh di , aur taaron (stars) se bhi log hidayat paate hain

verses.text_uthmani: أَفَمَن يَخْلُقُ كَمَن لَّا يَخْلُقُ ۗ أَفَلَا تَذَكَّرُونَ

translations.text: Can He who creates be compared to one who cannot create? Why do you not take heed?
Phir kya woh jo paida karta hai aur woh jo kuch bhi paida nahin karte, dono yaksan hain? Kya tum hosh mein nahin aatey

verses.text_uthmani: وَإِن تَعُدُّوا۟ نِعْمَةَ ٱللَّهِ لَا تُحْصُوهَآ ۗ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَغَفُورٌ رَّحِيمٌ

translations.text: If you tried to count God’s blessings, you could never take them all in: He is truly most forgiving and most merciful.
Agar tum Allah ki niyamaton ko ginna chaho to gin nahin sakte, haqeeqat yeh hai ke woh bada hi darguzar karne wala aur raheem hai

verses.text_uthmani: وَٱللَّهُ يَعْلَمُ مَا تُسِرُّونَ وَمَا تُعْلِنُونَ

translations.text: He knows what you conceal and what you reveal.
Halanke woh tumhare khule se bhi waqif hai aur chupey se bhi

verses.text_uthmani: وَٱلَّذِينَ يَدْعُونَ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ لَا يَخْلُقُونَ شَيْـًٔا وَهُمْ يُخْلَقُونَ

translations.text: Those they invoke beside God create nothing; they are themselves created.
Aur woh dusri hastiyan jinhein Allah ko chodh kar log pukarte hain, woh kisi cheez ke bhi khaliq nahin hain balke khud makhlooq hain

verses.text_uthmani: أَمْوَٰتٌ غَيْرُ أَحْيَآءٍ ۖ وَمَا يَشْعُرُونَ أَيَّانَ يُبْعَثُونَ

translations.text: They are dead, not living. They do not know when they will be raised up.
Murda hain na ke zinda aur unko kuch maloom nahin hai ke unhein kab (dobara zinda karke) uthaya jayega

verses.text_uthmani: إِلَـٰهُكُمْ إِلَـٰهٌ وَٰحِدٌ ۚ فَٱلَّذِينَ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ بِٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ قُلُوبُهُم مُّنكِرَةٌ وَهُم مُّسْتَكْبِرُونَ

translations.text: Your God is the One God. As for those who deny the life to come, their hearts refuse to admit the truth and they are arrogant.
Tumhara khuda bas ek hi khuda hai magar jo log aakhirat ko nahin maante unke dilon mein inkar baskar reh gaya hai aur woh ghamand mein padh gaye hain

verses.text_uthmani: لَا جَرَمَ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَعْلَمُ مَا يُسِرُّونَ وَمَا يُعْلِنُونَ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ لَا يُحِبُّ ٱلْمُسْتَكْبِرِينَ

translations.text: There is no doubt that God knows what they conceal and what they reveal. He does not love the arrogant.
Allah yaqeenan inke sab karoot jaanta hai chupe huye bhi aur khule huye bhi. Woh un logon ko hargiz pasand nahin karta jo guroor e nafs (puffed up with pride) mein mubtala hon

verses.text_uthmani: وَإِذَا قِيلَ لَهُم مَّاذَآ أَنزَلَ رَبُّكُمْ ۙ قَالُوٓا۟ أَسَـٰطِيرُ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ

translations.text: When they are asked, ‘What has your Lord sent down?’ they say, ‘Ancient fables.’
Aur jab koi unse poochta hai ke tumhare Rubb ne yeh kya cheez nazil ki hai to kehte hain, “aji woh to agle waqton ki farsuda kahaniyan (ancient tales) hain”

verses.text_uthmani: لِيَحْمِلُوٓا۟ أَوْزَارَهُمْ كَامِلَةً يَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَـٰمَةِ ۙ وَمِنْ أَوْزَارِ ٱلَّذِينَ يُضِلُّونَهُم بِغَيْرِ عِلْمٍ ۗ أَلَا سَآءَ مَا يَزِرُونَ

translations.text: On the Day of Resurrection they will bear the full weight of their own burden, as well as some of the burden of those they misled with no true knowledge. How terrible their burden will be!

Yeh baatein woh isliye karte hain ke qayamat ke roz apne bojh bhi poore uthayein, aur saath saath kuch un logon ke bojh bhi sametein jinhien yeh baar binaye jihalat (in their ignorance) gumraah kar rahey hain. Dekho! Kaisi sakht zimmedari hai jo yeh apne sar ley rahey hain

verses.text_uthmani: قَدْ مَكَرَ ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِهِمْ فَأَتَى ٱللَّهُ بُنْيَـٰنَهُم مِّنَ ٱلْقَوَاعِدِ فَخَرَّ عَلَيْهِمُ ٱلسَّقْفُ مِن فَوْقِهِمْ وَأَتَىٰهُمُ ٱلْعَذَابُ مِنْ حَيْثُ لَا يَشْعُرُونَ

translations.text: Those who went before them also schemed, but God attacked the very foundations of what they built. The roof fell down on them: punishment came on them from unimagined directions.

Inse pehle bhi bahut se log (haqq ko nicha dikhane ke liye) aisi hi makkariyan kar chuke hain, to dekhlo ke Allah ne unke makr ki imarat jadd (root) se ukhad phenki aur uski chatt upar se unke sar par aa rahi (roof fell down upon their heads from above them) aur aisey rukh se unpar azaab aaya jidhar se uske aane ka unko gumaan tak na tha

verses.text_uthmani: ثُمَّ يَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَـٰمَةِ يُخْزِيهِمْ وَيَقُولُ أَيْنَ شُرَكَآءِىَ ٱلَّذِينَ كُنتُمْ تُشَـٰٓقُّونَ فِيهِمْ ۚ قَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ أُوتُوا۟ ٱلْعِلْمَ إِنَّ ٱلْخِزْىَ ٱلْيَوْمَ وَٱلسُّوٓءَ عَلَى ٱلْكَـٰفِرِينَ

translations.text: In the end, on the Day of Resurrection, He will shame them, saying, ‘Where are these “partners” of Mine on whose account you opposed [Me]?’ Those given knowledge will say, ‘Shame and misery on the disbelievers today!’

Phir qayamat ke roz Allah unhein zaleel o khwar karega aur unse kahega “ batao, ab kahan hain mere woh shareek jinke liye tum (ehle haqq se) jhagde kiya karte thay?” Jin logon ko duniya mein ilm haasil tha woh kahenge “ aaj ruswayi aur badbakhti hai kafiron ke liye”

verses.text_uthmani: ٱلَّذِينَ تَتَوَفَّىٰهُمُ ٱلْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةُ ظَالِمِىٓ أَنفُسِهِمْ ۖ فَأَلْقَوُا۟ ٱلسَّلَمَ مَا كُنَّا نَعْمَلُ مِن سُوٓءٍۭ ۚ بَلَىٰٓ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ عَلِيمٌۢ بِمَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ

translations.text: Those whose lives the angels take while they are wronging themselves will show submission: ‘We were doing no evil.’ ‘Yes you were: God knows fully everything that you have done,

Haan, unhi kaafiron ke liye jo apne nafs par zulm karte huey jab malaika ke haathon giraftar hotay hain to (sarkashi chodh kar) fawran dagein daal dete (surrender) hain aur kehte hain “hum to koi kasoor nahin kar rahey thay”. Malaika jawab dete hain “kar kaise nahin rahey thay! Allah tumhare kartooton se khoob waqif hai

verses.text_uthmani: فَٱدْخُلُوٓا۟ أَبْوَٰبَ جَهَنَّمَ خَـٰلِدِينَ فِيهَا ۖ فَلَبِئْسَ مَثْوَى ٱلْمُتَكَبِّرِينَ

translations.text: so enter the gates of Hell. There you will remain- the home of the arrogant is evil indeed.’
Ab jao, jahannum ke darwazon mein ghuss jao, wahin tumko hamesha rehna hai”. Pas haqeeqat yeh hai ke bada hi bura thikana hai mutakabbiron (haughty ones) ke liye

verses.text_uthmani: ۞ وَقِيلَ لِلَّذِينَ ٱتَّقَوْا۟ مَاذَآ أَنزَلَ رَبُّكُمْ ۚ قَالُوا۟ خَيْرًا ۗ لِّلَّذِينَ أَحْسَنُوا۟ فِى هَـٰذِهِ ٱلدُّنْيَا حَسَنَةٌ ۚ وَلَدَارُ ٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ خَيْرٌ ۚ وَلَنِعْمَ دَارُ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ

translations.text: But when the righteous are asked, ‘What has your Lord sent down?’ they will say, ‘All that is good.’ There is a reward in this present world for those who do good, but their home in the Hereafter is far better: the home of the righteous is excellent.

Dusri taraf jab khuda tars logon se pucha jata hai ke yeh kya cheez hai jo tumhare Rubb ki taraf se nazil hui hai, to woh jawab dete hain ke “behtareen cheez utari hai”. Is tarah ke neikukar logon ke liye is duniya mein bhi bhalayi hai aur aakhirat ka ghar to zaroor hi unke haqq mein behtar hai. Bada accha ghar hai muttaqiyon (Allah se darne walon) ka

verses.text_uthmani: جَنَّـٰتُ عَدْنٍ يَدْخُلُونَهَا تَجْرِى مِن تَحْتِهَا ٱلْأَنْهَـٰرُ ۖ لَهُمْ فِيهَا مَا يَشَآءُونَ ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ يَجْزِى ٱللَّهُ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ

translations.text: They will enter perpetual Gardens graced with flowing streams. There they will have everything they wish. This is the way God rewards the righteous,

Daimi qayam (permanent residence) ki jannatein, jin mein woh dakhil hongey, nichey nehrein beh rahi hongi, aur sab kuch wahan ain unki khwahish ke mutabiq hoga. Yeh jaza deta hai Allah muttaqiyon (pious) ko

verses.text_uthmani: ٱلَّذِينَ تَتَوَفَّىٰهُمُ ٱلْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةُ طَيِّبِينَ ۙ يَقُولُونَ سَلَـٰمٌ عَلَيْكُمُ ٱدْخُلُوا۟ ٱلْجَنَّةَ بِمَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ

translations.text: those whose lives the angels take in a state of goodness. They will say to them, ‘Peace be upon you. Enter the Garden as a reward for what you have done.’
Un muttaqiyon ko jinki roohein pakeezgi ki haalat mein jab malaika qabz karte hain to kehte hain “salaam ho tumpar, jao jannat mein apne aamaal ke badle”

verses.text_uthmani: هَلْ يَنظُرُونَ إِلَّآ أَن تَأْتِيَهُمُ ٱلْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةُ أَوْ يَأْتِىَ أَمْرُ رَبِّكَ ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ فَعَلَ ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِهِمْ ۚ وَمَا ظَلَمَهُمُ ٱللَّهُ وَلَـٰكِن كَانُوٓا۟ أَنفُسَهُمْ يَظْلِمُونَ

translations.text: Are the disbelievers waiting for the angels to come to them, or your Lord’s Judgement? Those who went before them did the same. God did not wrong them; they wronged themselves.

(Aey Muhammad), ab jo yeh log intezar kar rahey hain to iske siwa ab aur kya baki reh gaya hai ke Malaika hi aa pahunchein, ya tere Rubb ka faisla saadir ho jaye? Is tarah ki dhitayi inse pehle bahut se log kar chuke hain, phir jo kuch unke saath hua woh unpar Allah ka zulm na tha balke unka apna zulm tha jo unhon ne khud apne upar kiya

verses.text_uthmani: فَأَصَابَهُمْ سَيِّـَٔاتُ مَا عَمِلُوا۟ وَحَاقَ بِهِم مَّا كَانُوا۟ بِهِۦ يَسْتَهْزِءُونَ

translations.text: So the evil they had done hit them and they were surrounded by the very thing they had mocked.
Unke kartooton ki kharabiyan aakhir unki daamangeer ho gayi aur wahi cheez unpar musallat hokar rahi jiska woh mazaaq udaya karte thay

verses.text_uthmani: وَقَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ أَشْرَكُوا۟ لَوْ شَآءَ ٱللَّهُ مَا عَبَدْنَا مِن دُونِهِۦ مِن شَىْءٍ نَّحْنُ وَلَآ ءَابَآؤُنَا وَلَا حَرَّمْنَا مِن دُونِهِۦ مِن شَىْءٍ ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ فَعَلَ ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِهِمْ ۚ فَهَلْ عَلَى ٱلرُّسُلِ إِلَّا ٱلْبَلَـٰغُ ٱلْمُبِينُ

translations.text: Those who worshipped others alongside God say, ‘If God had willed, we would not have worshipped anything but Him, nor would our fathers. We would not have declared anything forbidden without His sanction.’ Those before them said the same. Are the messengers obliged to do anything other than deliver [their message] clearly?

Yeh mushrikeen kehte hain “agar Allah chahta to na hum aur na hamare baap dada uske siwa kisi aur ki ibadat karte aur na uske hukum ke bagair kisi cheez ko haraam thehrate”. Aisey hi bahane insey pehle ke log bhi banate rahey hain to kya Rasoolon par saaf saaf baat pahuncha dene ke siwa aur bhi koi zimmedari hai

verses.text_uthmani: وَلَقَدْ بَعَثْنَا فِى كُلِّ أُمَّةٍ رَّسُولًا أَنِ ٱعْبُدُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَٱجْتَنِبُوا۟ ٱلطَّـٰغُوتَ ۖ فَمِنْهُم مَّنْ هَدَى ٱللَّهُ وَمِنْهُم مَّنْ حَقَّتْ عَلَيْهِ ٱلضَّلَـٰلَةُ ۚ فَسِيرُوا۟ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ فَٱنظُرُوا۟ كَيْفَ كَانَ عَـٰقِبَةُ ٱلْمُكَذِّبِينَ

translations.text: We sent a messenger to every community, saying, ‘Worship God and shun false gods.’ Among them were some God guided; misguidance took hold of others. So travel through the earth and see what was the fate of those who denied the truth.

Humne har ummat mein ek Rasool bhej diya, aur uske zariye se sabko khabardar kardiya ke “Allah ki bandagi karo aur taghut ki bandagi se bacho”. Iske baad in mein se kisi ko Allah ne hidayat bakshi aur kisi par zalalat musallat ho gayi. Phir zara zameen mein chal phir kar dekhlo ke jhutlane walon ka kya anjaam ho chuka hai

verses.text_uthmani: إِن تَحْرِصْ عَلَىٰ هُدَىٰهُمْ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَا يَهْدِى مَن يُضِلُّ ۖ وَمَا لَهُم مِّن نَّـٰصِرِينَ

translations.text: Though you [Prophet] may be eager to guide them, God does not guide those who misguide [others], nor will they have anyone to help them.
(Aey Muhammad), tum chahe inki hidayat ke liye kitne hi harees (desirous) ho, magar Allah jisko bhatka deta hai phir usey hidayat nahin diya karta aur is tarah ke logon ki madad koi nahin kar sakta

verses.text_uthmani: وَأَقْسَمُوا۟ بِٱللَّهِ جَهْدَ أَيْمَـٰنِهِمْ ۙ لَا يَبْعَثُ ٱللَّهُ مَن يَمُوتُ ۚ بَلَىٰ وَعْدًا عَلَيْهِ حَقًّا وَلَـٰكِنَّ أَكْثَرَ ٱلنَّاسِ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ

translations.text: They have sworn by God with their strongest oaths that He will not raise the dead to life. But He will- it is His binding promise, though most people do not realize it-

Yeh log Allah ke naam se kadi kadi kasmein kha kar kehte hain ke “Allah kisi marne waley ko phir se zinda karke na uthayega”. Uthayega kyun nahin, yeh to ek wada hai jisey poora karna usne apne upar wajib karliye hai, magar aksar log jantey nahin hain

verses.text_uthmani: لِيُبَيِّنَ لَهُمُ ٱلَّذِى يَخْتَلِفُونَ فِيهِ وَلِيَعْلَمَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوٓا۟ أَنَّهُمْ كَانُوا۟ كَـٰذِبِينَ

translations.text: in order to make clear for them what they have differed about and so that the disbelievers may realize that what they said was false.
Aur aisa hona isliye zaroori hai ke Allah inke samne us haqeeqat ko khol de jiske barey mein yeh ikhtilaf kar rahey hain aur munkireen e haqq ko maloom ho jaye ke woh jhoote thay

verses.text_uthmani: إِنَّمَا قَوْلُنَا لِشَىْءٍ إِذَآ أَرَدْنَـٰهُ أَن نَّقُولَ لَهُۥ كُن فَيَكُونُ

translations.text: When We will something to happen, all that We say is, ‘Be,’ and it is.
Raha uska imakan (possibility) to] humein kisi cheez ko wajood mein laney ke liye issey zyada kuch nahin karna hota ke usey hukum dein “ho ja” aur bas woh ho jaati hai

verses.text_uthmani: وَٱلَّذِينَ هَاجَرُوا۟ فِى ٱللَّهِ مِنۢ بَعْدِ مَا ظُلِمُوا۟ لَنُبَوِّئَنَّهُمْ فِى ٱلدُّنْيَا حَسَنَةً ۖ وَلَأَجْرُ ٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ أَكْبَرُ ۚ لَوْ كَانُوا۟ يَعْلَمُونَ

translations.text: As for those who emi-grated in God’s cause after being wronged, We shall give them a good home in this world, but the reward of the Hereafter will be far greater, if they only knew it.
Jo log zulm sehne ke baad Allah ki khatir hijrat kar gaye hain unko hum duniya hi mein accha thikana denge aur aakhirat ka ajar to bahut bada hai, kaash jaan lein woh mazloom

verses.text_uthmani: ٱلَّذِينَ صَبَرُوا۟ وَعَلَىٰ رَبِّهِمْ يَتَوَكَّلُونَ

translations.text: They are the ones who are steadfast and put their trust in their Lord.
Jinhon ne sabr kiya hai aur jo apne Rubb ke bharosey par kaam kar rahey hain (ke kaisa accha anjaam unka muntazir hai)

verses.text_uthmani: وَمَآ أَرْسَلْنَا مِن قَبْلِكَ إِلَّا رِجَالًا نُّوحِىٓ إِلَيْهِمْ ۚ فَسْـَٔلُوٓا۟ أَهْلَ ٱلذِّكْرِ إِن كُنتُمْ لَا تَعْلَمُونَ

translations.text: [Prophet], all the messengers We sent before you were simply men to whom We had given the Revelation: you [people] can ask those who have knowledge if you do not know.
(Aey Muhammad), humne tumse pehle bhi jab kabhi Rasool bheje hain aadmi hi bheje hain jinki taraf hum apne paigamaat wahee kiya karte thay. Ehle zikr se puch lo agar tumlog khud nahin jaante

verses.text_uthmani: بِٱلْبَيِّنَـٰتِ وَٱلزُّبُرِ ۗ وَأَنزَلْنَآ إِلَيْكَ ٱلذِّكْرَ لِتُبَيِّنَ لِلنَّاسِ مَا نُزِّلَ إِلَيْهِمْ وَلَعَلَّهُمْ يَتَفَكَّرُونَ

translations.text: We sent them with clear signs and scriptures. We have sent down the message to you too [Prophet], so that you can explain to people what was sent for them, so that they may reflect.

Pichle Rasoolon ko bhi humne roshan nishaniyan aur kitabein de kar bheja tha, aur ab yeh zikr tumpar nazil kiya hai taa-ke tum logon ke saamne us taleem ki tashreeh o tawzeeh karte jao jo unke liye utari gayi hai, aur taa-ke log (khud bhi) gaur o fikr karein

verses.text_uthmani: أَفَأَمِنَ ٱلَّذِينَ مَكَرُوا۟ ٱلسَّيِّـَٔاتِ أَن يَخْسِفَ ٱللَّهُ بِهِمُ ٱلْأَرْضَ أَوْ يَأْتِيَهُمُ ٱلْعَذَابُ مِنْ حَيْثُ لَا يَشْعُرُونَ

translations.text: Are those who plan evil so sure that God will not make the earth swallow them up, that punishment will not come on them from some unimagined direction,

Phir kya woh log jo ( dawat e paigambar ki mukhalifat mein) badhtar se badhtar chalein chal rahey hain is baat se bilkul hi be khauf ho gaye hain ke Allah unko zameen mein dhansa de, ya aisey goshey mein unpar azaab le aaye jidhar se uske aane ka unko weham o gumaan tak na ho

verses.text_uthmani: أَوْ يَأْخُذَهُمْ فِى تَقَلُّبِهِمْ فَمَا هُم بِمُعْجِزِينَ

translations.text: that it will not catch them suddenly in the midst of their comings and goings- for they cannot frustrate God-
Ya achanak chalte phirte inko pakad le , ya aisi halat mein inhein pakde jabke unhein khud aane wali museebat ka khatka laga hua ho aur woh ussey bachne ki fikr mein chaukanne hon

verses.text_uthmani: أَوْ يَأْخُذَهُمْ عَلَىٰ تَخَوُّفٍ فَإِنَّ رَبَّكُمْ لَرَءُوفٌ رَّحِيمٌ

translations.text: or that it will not catch up with them gradually? Indeed your Lord is kind and merciful.
Woh jo kuch bhi karna chahe yeh log usko aajiz (frustrate) karne ki taaqat nahin rakhte, haqeeqat yeh hai ke tumhara Rubb bada hi narm-khu (very Lenient /shafaqat karne wala) aur raheem hai

verses.text_uthmani: أَوَلَمْ يَرَوْا۟ إِلَىٰ مَا خَلَقَ ٱللَّهُ مِن شَىْءٍ يَتَفَيَّؤُا۟ ظِلَـٰلُهُۥ عَنِ ٱلْيَمِينِ وَٱلشَّمَآئِلِ سُجَّدًا لِّلَّهِ وَهُمْ دَٰخِرُونَ

translations.text: Do the [disbelievers] not observe the things that God has created, casting their shadows right and left, submitting themselves to God obediently?

Aur kya yeh log Allah ki paida ki hui kisi cheez ko bhi nahin dekhte ke uska saaya kis tarah Allah ke huzoor sajda karte huey dayein aur bayein girta hai? Sab ke sab is tarah izhar e ijz (express their humility) kar rahey hain

verses.text_uthmani: وَلِلَّهِ يَسْجُدُ مَا فِى ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَمَا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ مِن دَآبَّةٍ وَٱلْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةُ وَهُمْ لَا يَسْتَكْبِرُونَ

translations.text: It is to God that everything in the heavens and earth submits, every beast that moves, even the angels- they are free from arrogance:
Zameen aur aasmano mein jis qadar jaandaar makhlooqat hain aur jitne Malaika hain sab Allah ke aagey sar ba-sajood hain. Woh hargiz sarkashi nahin karte

verses.text_uthmani: يَخَافُونَ رَبَّهُم مِّن فَوْقِهِمْ وَيَفْعَلُونَ مَا يُؤْمَرُونَ ۩

translations.text: they fear their Lord above them, and they do as they are commanded.
Apne Rubb se jo unke upar hai, darte hain aur jo kuch hukum diya jata hai usi ke mutabik kaam karte hain

verses.text_uthmani: ۞ وَقَالَ ٱللَّهُ لَا تَتَّخِذُوٓا۟ إِلَـٰهَيْنِ ٱثْنَيْنِ ۖ إِنَّمَا هُوَ إِلَـٰهٌ وَٰحِدٌ ۖ فَإِيَّـٰىَ فَٱرْهَبُونِ

translations.text: God said, ‘Do not take two gods’- for He is the One God––‘ I alone am the One that you should hold in awe.’
Allah ka farmaan hai ke “do khuda na bana lo, khuda to bas ek hi hai, lihaza tum mujhi se daro

verses.text_uthmani: وَلَهُۥ مَا فِى ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَلَهُ ٱلدِّينُ وَاصِبًا ۚ أَفَغَيْرَ ٱللَّهِ تَتَّقُونَ

translations.text: Everything in the heavens and earth belongs to Him: everlasting obedience is His right. Will you heed anyone other than God?
Usi ka hai woh sab kuch jo aasmano mein hai aur jo zameen mein hai, aur khaalisan usi ka deen (saari qayinaat mein) chal raha hai. Phir kya Allah ko chodh kar tum kisi aur se taqwa (darr) karoge

verses.text_uthmani: وَمَا بِكُم مِّن نِّعْمَةٍ فَمِنَ ٱللَّهِ ۖ ثُمَّ إِذَا مَسَّكُمُ ٱلضُّرُّ فَإِلَيْهِ تَجْـَٔرُونَ

translations.text: Whatever good things you possess come from God, and when hardship afflicts you, it is to Him alone you cry out for help,
Tumko jo niyamat bhi haasil hai Allah hi ki taraf se hai phir jab koi sakht waqt tumpar aata hai to tum log khud apni fariyadein lekar usi ki taraf daudte ho

verses.text_uthmani: ثُمَّ إِذَا كَشَفَ ٱلضُّرَّ عَنكُمْ إِذَا فَرِيقٌ مِّنكُم بِرَبِّهِمْ يُشْرِكُونَ

translations.text: yet when He has relieved you of your hardship- lo and behold!- some of you attribute partners to your Lord.
Magar jab Allah us waqt ko taal deta hai to yakayak tum mein se ek giroh apne Rubb ke saath dusron ko (is meharbani ke shukriye mein) shareek karne lagta hai

verses.text_uthmani: لِيَكْفُرُوا۟ بِمَآ ءَاتَيْنَـٰهُمْ ۚ فَتَمَتَّعُوا۟ ۖ فَسَوْفَ تَعْلَمُونَ

translations.text: Let them show ingratitude for the favours We have shown them; ‘Enjoy your brief time- soon you will know.’
Taa-ke Allah ke ehsan ki nashukri karey, Accha mazey karlo, anqareeb tumhein maloom ho jayega

verses.text_uthmani: وَيَجْعَلُونَ لِمَا لَا يَعْلَمُونَ نَصِيبًا مِّمَّا رَزَقْنَـٰهُمْ ۗ تَٱللَّهِ لَتُسْـَٔلُنَّ عَمَّا كُنتُمْ تَفْتَرُونَ

translations.text: They set aside part of the sustenance We give them, for [idols] about which they have no true knowledge. By God! You will be questioned about your false inventions.
Yeh log jinki haqeeqat se waqif nahin hain unke hissey hamare diye huye rizq mein se muqarrar karte hain. Khuda ki kasam, zaroor tumse pucha jayega ke yeh jhoot tumne kaise ghadh liye thay

verses.text_uthmani: وَيَجْعَلُونَ لِلَّهِ ٱلْبَنَـٰتِ سُبْحَـٰنَهُۥ ۙ وَلَهُم مَّا يَشْتَهُونَ

translations.text: They assign daughters to God––may He be exalted!––and the [sons] they desire to themselves.
Yeh khuda ke liye betiyan tajweez karte hain, SubhanAllah! Aur inke liye woh jo yeh khud chahein

verses.text_uthmani: وَإِذَا بُشِّرَ أَحَدُهُم بِٱلْأُنثَىٰ ظَلَّ وَجْهُهُۥ مُسْوَدًّا وَهُوَ كَظِيمٌ

translations.text: When one of them is given news of the birth of a baby girl, his face darkens and he is filled with gloom.
Jab in mein se kisi ko beti ke paida honay ki khush-khabri di jati hai to uske chehre par kaloons (grows dark) chaa jati hai aur woh bas khoon ka sa ghoont pee kar reh jata hai

verses.text_uthmani: يَتَوَٰرَىٰ مِنَ ٱلْقَوْمِ مِن سُوٓءِ مَا بُشِّرَ بِهِۦٓ ۚ أَيُمْسِكُهُۥ عَلَىٰ هُونٍ أَمْ يَدُسُّهُۥ فِى ٱلتُّرَابِ ۗ أَلَا سَآءَ مَا يَحْكُمُونَ

translations.text: In his shame he hides himself away from his people because of the bad news he has been given. Should he keep her and suffer contempt or bury her in the dust? How ill they judge!

Logon se chupta phirta hai ke is buri khabar ke baad kya kisi ko mooh dikhaye. Sochta hai ke zillat ke saath beti ko liye rahey ya mitti mein daba de? Dekho kaise bure hukum hain jo yeh khuda ke barey mein lagate hain

verses.text_uthmani: لِلَّذِينَ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ بِٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ مَثَلُ ٱلسَّوْءِ ۖ وَلِلَّهِ ٱلْمَثَلُ ٱلْأَعْلَىٰ ۚ وَهُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلْحَكِيمُ

translations.text: Those who do not believe in the Hereafter should have the contemptible image, and God should have the highest one: He is the Mighty, the Wise.

Buri siffat se muttasaf (be ascribed) kiya janey ke layak to woh log hain jo aakhirat ka yaqeen nahin rakhte. Raha Allah, to uske liye sab se bartar siffat hain, wahi to sab par gaalib aur hikmat mein kamil hai

verses.text_uthmani: وَلَوْ يُؤَاخِذُ ٱللَّهُ ٱلنَّاسَ بِظُلْمِهِم مَّا تَرَكَ عَلَيْهَا مِن دَآبَّةٍ وَلَـٰكِن يُؤَخِّرُهُمْ إِلَىٰٓ أَجَلٍ مُّسَمًّى ۖ فَإِذَا جَآءَ أَجَلُهُمْ لَا يَسْتَـْٔخِرُونَ سَاعَةً ۖ وَلَا يَسْتَقْدِمُونَ

translations.text: If God took people to task for the evil they do, He would not leave one living creature on earth, but He reprieves them until an appointed time: when their time comes they cannot delay it for a moment nor can they bring it forward.

Agar kahin Allah logon ko unki zyadati par fauran hi pakad liya karta to rooh e zameen par kisi mutanaffis ko na chodhta. Lekin woh sab ko ek waqt e muqarrar tak mohalat deta hai. Phir jab woh waqt aa jata hai to ussey koi ek ghadi bhar bhi aagey peechey nahin ho sakta

verses.text_uthmani: وَيَجْعَلُونَ لِلَّهِ مَا يَكْرَهُونَ وَتَصِفُ أَلْسِنَتُهُمُ ٱلْكَذِبَ أَنَّ لَهُمُ ٱلْحُسْنَىٰ ۖ لَا جَرَمَ أَنَّ لَهُمُ ٱلنَّارَ وَأَنَّهُم مُّفْرَطُونَ

translations.text: They attribute to God what they themselves dislike while their own tongues utter the lie that the best belongs to them. Without doubt it is the Fire that belongs to them: they will be given priority there!

Aaj yeh log woh cheezein Allah ke liye tajweez kar rahey hain jo khud apne liye inhein napasand hain, aur jhoot kehti hain inki zubaanein ke inke liye bhala hi bhala hai. Inke liye to ek hi cheez hai, aur woh hai dozakh ki aag, zaroor yeh sab se pehle us mein pahunchaye jayenge

verses.text_uthmani: تَٱللَّهِ لَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَآ إِلَىٰٓ أُمَمٍ مِّن قَبْلِكَ فَزَيَّنَ لَهُمُ ٱلشَّيْطَـٰنُ أَعْمَـٰلَهُمْ فَهُوَ وَلِيُّهُمُ ٱلْيَوْمَ وَلَهُمْ عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌ

translations.text: By God, We have sent messengers before you [Muhammad] to other communities, but Satan made their foul deeds seem alluring to them. He is the patron of these present disbelievers too, and a painful punishment awaits them all.

Khuda ki kasam, (aey Muhammad) tumse pehle bhi bahut si qaumon mein hum Rasool bhej chuke hain (aur pehle bhi yahi hota raha hai ke) shaytan ne unke burey kartoot unhein khushnuma bana kar dikhaye (aur Rasoolon ki baat unhon ne maan kar na di). Wahi shaytan aaj in logon ka bhi sarparast bana hua hai aur yeh dardnaak saza ke mustahiq ban rahey hain

verses.text_uthmani: وَمَآ أَنزَلْنَا عَلَيْكَ ٱلْكِتَـٰبَ إِلَّا لِتُبَيِّنَ لَهُمُ ٱلَّذِى ٱخْتَلَفُوا۟ فِيهِ ۙ وَهُدًى وَرَحْمَةً لِّقَوْمٍ يُؤْمِنُونَ

translations.text: We have sent down the Scripture to you only to make clear to them what they differ about, and as guidance and mercy to those who believe.

Humne yeh kitaab tumpar is liye nazil ki hai ke tum un ikhtilafaat(differences) ki haqeeqat inpar khol do jin mein yeh padey huey hain. Yeh kitab rehnumayi aur rehmat bankar utri hai un logon ke liye jo isey maan lein

verses.text_uthmani: وَٱللَّهُ أَنزَلَ مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَآءً فَأَحْيَا بِهِ ٱلْأَرْضَ بَعْدَ مَوْتِهَآ ۚ إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَةً لِّقَوْمٍ يَسْمَعُونَ

translations.text: It is God who sends water down from the sky and with it revives the earth when it is dead. There truly is a sign in this for people who listen.
(Tum har barsaat mein dekhte ho ke) Allah ne aasman se pani barsaya aur yakayak murda padi hui zameen mein uski badaulat jaan daal di. Yaqeenan is mein ek nishani hain sunne walon ke liye

verses.text_uthmani: وَإِنَّ لَكُمْ فِى ٱلْأَنْعَـٰمِ لَعِبْرَةً ۖ نُّسْقِيكُم مِّمَّا فِى بُطُونِهِۦ مِنۢ بَيْنِ فَرْثٍ وَدَمٍ لَّبَنًا خَالِصًا سَآئِغًا لِّلشَّـٰرِبِينَ

translations.text: In livestock, too, you have a lesson- We give you a drink from the contents of their bellies, between waste matter and blood, pure milk, sweet to the drinker.

Aur tumhare liye maweshiyon mein bhi ek sabaq maujood hai unke pait (stomach) se gobar aur khoon ke darmiyan hum ek cheez tumhein peelate hain, yaani khaalis doodh, jo peene walon ke liye nihayat khushgawar hai

verses.text_uthmani: وَمِن ثَمَرَٰتِ ٱلنَّخِيلِ وَٱلْأَعْنَـٰبِ تَتَّخِذُونَ مِنْهُ سَكَرًا وَرِزْقًا حَسَنًا ۗ إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَةً لِّقَوْمٍ يَعْقِلُونَ

translations.text: From the fruits of date palms and grapes you take sweet juice and wholesome provisions. There truly is a sign in this for people who use their reason.

(Isi tarah) khajoor ke darakhton aur angoor ki beilon se bhi hum ek cheez tumhein pilatay hain jisey tum nasha-awar bhi bana letey ho aur paak rizq bhi. Yaqeenan is mein ek nishani hai aqal se kaam lene walon ke liye

verses.text_uthmani: وَأَوْحَىٰ رَبُّكَ إِلَى ٱلنَّحْلِ أَنِ ٱتَّخِذِى مِنَ ٱلْجِبَالِ بُيُوتًا وَمِنَ ٱلشَّجَرِ وَمِمَّا يَعْرِشُونَ

translations.text: And your Lord inspired the bee, saying, ‘Build yourselves houses in the mountains and trees and what people construct.

Aur dekho, tumhare Rubb ne shahed (honey) ki makkhi par yeh baat wahee kardi ke pahadon mein, aur darakhton mein, aur tattiyon par chadhayi hui bailon mein (mountains, trees and in the creepers over trellises) apne chattey bana (Build your hive)

verses.text_uthmani: ثُمَّ كُلِى مِن كُلِّ ٱلثَّمَرَٰتِ فَٱسْلُكِى سُبُلَ رَبِّكِ ذُلُلًا ۚ يَخْرُجُ مِنۢ بُطُونِهَا شَرَابٌ مُّخْتَلِفٌ أَلْوَٰنُهُۥ فِيهِ شِفَآءٌ لِّلنَّاسِ ۗ إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَةً لِّقَوْمٍ يَتَفَكَّرُونَ

translations.text: Then feed on all kinds of fruit and follow the ways made easy for you by your Lord.’ From their bellies comes a drink of different colours in which there is healing for people. There truly is a sign in this for those who think.

Aur har tarah ke phoolon ka rass choos aur apne Rubb ki humwar ki hui raahon par chalti reh. Is makkhi ke andar se rang bi rang ka ek sharbat nikalta hai jismein shifa hai logon ke liye. Yaqeenan is mein bhi ek nishani hai un logon ke liye jo gaur o fikr karte hain

verses.text_uthmani: وَٱللَّهُ خَلَقَكُمْ ثُمَّ يَتَوَفَّىٰكُمْ ۚ وَمِنكُم مَّن يُرَدُّ إِلَىٰٓ أَرْذَلِ ٱلْعُمُرِ لِكَىْ لَا يَعْلَمَ بَعْدَ عِلْمٍ شَيْـًٔا ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ عَلِيمٌ قَدِيرٌ

translations.text: It is God who has created you and in time will cause you to die. Some of you will be reduced, in old age, to a most abject state, so that, after having knowledge, they will know nothing at all: God is truly all knowing and all powerful.

Aur dekho, Allah ne tumko paida kiya, phir woh tumko maut deta hai aur tum mein se koi badhtareen umar ko pahucha diya jata hai taa-ke sab kuch jaanne ke baad phir kuch na janey. Haqq yeh hai ke Allah hi ilm mein bhi kamil hai aur qudrat mein bhi

verses.text_uthmani: وَٱللَّهُ فَضَّلَ بَعْضَكُمْ عَلَىٰ بَعْضٍ فِى ٱلرِّزْقِ ۚ فَمَا ٱلَّذِينَ فُضِّلُوا۟ بِرَآدِّى رِزْقِهِمْ عَلَىٰ مَا مَلَكَتْ أَيْمَـٰنُهُمْ فَهُمْ فِيهِ سَوَآءٌ ۚ أَفَبِنِعْمَةِ ٱللَّهِ يَجْحَدُونَ

translations.text: God has given some of you more provision than others. Those who have been given more are unwilling to pass their provision on to the slaves they possess so that they become their equals. How can they refuse to acknowledge God’s blessings?

Aur dekho, Allah ne tum mein se baaz ko baaz par rizq mein fazilat ata ki hai, phir jin logon ko yeh fazeelat di gayi hai woh aisey nahin hain ke apna rizq apne ghulaamo ki taraf pher diya karte hon taa-ke dono is rizq mein barabar ke hissedaar ban jayein. To kya Allah hi ka ehsan maanne se in logon ko inkar hai

verses.text_uthmani: وَٱللَّهُ جَعَلَ لَكُم مِّنْ أَنفُسِكُمْ أَزْوَٰجًا وَجَعَلَ لَكُم مِّنْ أَزْوَٰجِكُم بَنِينَ وَحَفَدَةً وَرَزَقَكُم مِّنَ ٱلطَّيِّبَـٰتِ ۚ أَفَبِٱلْبَـٰطِلِ يُؤْمِنُونَ وَبِنِعْمَتِ ٱللَّهِ هُمْ يَكْفُرُونَ

translations.text: And it is God who has given you spouses from amongst yourselves and through them He has given you children and grandchildren and provided you with good things. How can they believe in falsehood and deny God’s blessings?

Aur woh Allah hi hai jisne tumhare liye tumhari hum jins biwiyan banayi aur usi ne un biwiyon se tumhein bete potey (sons and grandsons) ata kiye aur acchi acchi cheezein tumhein khane ko di. Phir kya yeh log (yeh sab kuch dekhte aur jaante huey bhi) baatil ko maante hain, aur Allah ke ehsan ka inkar karte hain

verses.text_uthmani: وَيَعْبُدُونَ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ مَا لَا يَمْلِكُ لَهُمْ رِزْقًا مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ شَيْـًٔا وَلَا يَسْتَطِيعُونَ

translations.text: Those they worship beside God have no power to provide anything for them from the heavens or the earth: they can do nothing.
Aur Allah ko chodh kar unko poojhte hain jinke haath mein na aasmano se inhein kuch bhi rizq dena hai na zameen se aur na yeh kaam woh kar hi sakte hain

verses.text_uthmani: فَلَا تَضْرِبُوا۟ لِلَّهِ ٱلْأَمْثَالَ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَعْلَمُ وَأَنتُمْ لَا تَعْلَمُونَ

translations.text: So do not make up images about God: God knows and you do not.
Pas Allah ke liye misalein na ghado, Allah jaanta hai, tum nahin jaante

verses.text_uthmani: ۞ ضَرَبَ ٱللَّهُ مَثَلًا عَبْدًا مَّمْلُوكًا لَّا يَقْدِرُ عَلَىٰ شَىْءٍ وَمَن رَّزَقْنَـٰهُ مِنَّا رِزْقًا حَسَنًا فَهُوَ يُنفِقُ مِنْهُ سِرًّا وَجَهْرًا ۖ هَلْ يَسْتَوُۥنَ ۚ ٱلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ ۚ بَلْ أَكْثَرُهُمْ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ

translations.text: God presents this illustration: a slave controlled by his master, with no power over anything, and another man We have supplied with good provision, from which he gives alms privately and openly. Can they be considered equal? All praise belongs to God, but most of them do not recognize this.

Allah ek misal deta hai ek to hai gulaam, jo dusre ka mamluq (slave) hai aur khud koi ikhtiyar nahin rakhta. Doosra shaks aisa hai jisey humne apni taraf se accha rizq ata kiya hai aur woh is mein se khule aur chupe khoob kharch karta hai. Batao kya yeh dono barabar hain? Alhamdulillah, magar aksar log (is seedhi baat ko) nahin jaante

verses.text_uthmani: وَضَرَبَ ٱللَّهُ مَثَلًا رَّجُلَيْنِ أَحَدُهُمَآ أَبْكَمُ لَا يَقْدِرُ عَلَىٰ شَىْءٍ وَهُوَ كَلٌّ عَلَىٰ مَوْلَىٰهُ أَيْنَمَا يُوَجِّههُّ لَا يَأْتِ بِخَيْرٍ ۖ هَلْ يَسْتَوِى هُوَ وَمَن يَأْمُرُ بِٱلْعَدْلِ ۙ وَهُوَ عَلَىٰ صِرَٰطٍ مُّسْتَقِيمٍ

translations.text: God presents another illustration: two men, one of them dumb, unable to do anything, a burden to his carer- whatever task he directs him to, he achieves nothing good- can he be considered equal to one who commands justice and is on the straight path?

Allah ek aur misal deta hai, do aadmi hain ek gunga behra hai, koi kaam nahin kar sakta, apne aaqa par bojh bana hua hai, jidhar bhi woh usey bheje koi bhala kaam ussey ban na aaye, dusra shaks aisa hai ke insaaf ka hukum deta hai aur khud raah e raast par qayam hai, batao kya yeh dono yaksan hain

verses.text_uthmani: وَلِلَّهِ غَيْبُ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ۚ وَمَآ أَمْرُ ٱلسَّاعَةِ إِلَّا كَلَمْحِ ٱلْبَصَرِ أَوْ هُوَ أَقْرَبُ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ قَدِيرٌ

translations.text: All that is hidden from view in the heavens and earth belongs to God. The coming of the Hour of Judgement is like the blink of an eye, or even quicker: God has power over everything.

Aur zameen o aasman ke posheeda haqaiq ka ilm to Allah hi ko hai aur qayamant ke barpa honay ka maamla kuch dair na lega magar bas itni ke jismein aadmi ki palakh jhapak jaye, balke isse bhi kuch kam, haqeeqat yeh hai ke Allah sab kuch kar sakta hai

verses.text_uthmani: وَٱللَّهُ أَخْرَجَكُم مِّنۢ بُطُونِ أُمَّهَـٰتِكُمْ لَا تَعْلَمُونَ شَيْـًٔا وَجَعَلَ لَكُمُ ٱلسَّمْعَ وَٱلْأَبْصَـٰرَ وَٱلْأَفْـِٔدَةَ ۙ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَشْكُرُونَ

translations.text: It is God who brought you out of your mothers’ wombs knowing nothing, and gave you hearing and sight and minds, so that you might be thankful.
Allah ne tumko tumhari maaon ke paiton se nikala is halat mein ke tum kuch na jaante thay, usne tumhein kaan diye , aankhein di , aur sochne waley dil diya, is liye ke tum shukar-guzaar bano

verses.text_uthmani: أَلَمْ يَرَوْا۟ إِلَى ٱلطَّيْرِ مُسَخَّرَٰتٍ فِى جَوِّ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَا يُمْسِكُهُنَّ إِلَّا ٱللَّهُ ۗ إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَـٰتٍ لِّقَوْمٍ يُؤْمِنُونَ

translations.text: Do they not see the birds made to fly through the air in the sky? Nothing holds them up except God. There truly are signs in this for those who believe.

Kya in logon ne kabhi parindon ko nahin dekha ke fiza e aasmani mein kis tarah musakkhar hain? Allah ke siwa kisne inko thaam rakkha hai? Is mein bahut nishaniyan hain un logon ke liye jo iman latey hain

verses.text_uthmani: وَٱللَّهُ جَعَلَ لَكُم مِّنۢ بُيُوتِكُمْ سَكَنًا وَجَعَلَ لَكُم مِّن جُلُودِ ٱلْأَنْعَـٰمِ بُيُوتًا تَسْتَخِفُّونَهَا يَوْمَ ظَعْنِكُمْ وَيَوْمَ إِقَامَتِكُمْ ۙ وَمِنْ أَصْوَافِهَا وَأَوْبَارِهَا وَأَشْعَارِهَآ أَثَـٰثًا وَمَتَـٰعًا إِلَىٰ حِينٍ

translations.text: It is God who has given you a place of rest in your homes and from the skins of animals made you homes that you find light [to handle] when you travel and when you set up camp; furnishings and comfort for a while from their wool, fur, and hair.

Allah ne tumhare liye tumhare gharon ko jaaye sukoon banaya, usne jaanwaron ki khaalon (skins) se tumhare liye aisey makan paida kiye jinhein tum safar aur qayaam, dono haalaton mein halka patey ho. Usne jaanwaron ke souf aur oun aur baalon se (soft fur and wool and hair) pehanne aur baratne (use) ki bahut si cheezein paida kardi jo zindagi ki muddat e muqarrara tak tumhare kaam aati hain

verses.text_uthmani: وَٱللَّهُ جَعَلَ لَكُم مِّمَّا خَلَقَ ظِلَـٰلًا وَجَعَلَ لَكُم مِّنَ ٱلْجِبَالِ أَكْنَـٰنًا وَجَعَلَ لَكُمْ سَرَٰبِيلَ تَقِيكُمُ ٱلْحَرَّ وَسَرَٰبِيلَ تَقِيكُم بَأْسَكُمْ ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ يُتِمُّ نِعْمَتَهُۥ عَلَيْكُمْ لَعَلَّكُمْ تُسْلِمُونَ

translations.text: It is God who has given you shade from what He has created, and places of shelter in the mountains; garments to protect you from the heat, and garments to protect you in your wars. In this way He perfects His blessings on you, so that you may devote yourselves to Him.

Usne apni paida ki hui bahut si cheezon se tumhare liye saaye ka intezam kiya, pahadon mein tumhare liye panaah-gaahein (places of refuge) banayi, aur tumhein aisi poshakein (garments) bakshi jo tumhein garmi se bachati hain aur kuch dusri poshakein jo aapas ki jung mein tumhari hifazat karti hain, is tarah woh tumpar apni niyamaton ki takmeel karta hai shayad ke tum farmabardar bano

verses.text_uthmani: فَإِن تَوَلَّوْا۟ فَإِنَّمَا عَلَيْكَ ٱلْبَلَـٰغُ ٱلْمُبِينُ

translations.text: But if they turn away [Prophet], your only duty is to deliver the message clearly.
Ab agar yeh log mooh moadte hain to (aey Muhammad) , tumpar saaf saaf paighaam e haqq pahuncha dene ke siwa aur koi zimmedari nahin hai

verses.text_uthmani: يَعْرِفُونَ نِعْمَتَ ٱللَّهِ ثُمَّ يُنكِرُونَهَا وَأَكْثَرُهُمُ ٱلْكَـٰفِرُونَ

translations.text: They know God’s blessings, but refuse to recognize them: most of them are ungrateful.
Yeh Allah ke ehsan ko pehchante hain, phir iska inkar karte hain aur in mein beshtar aisey hain jo haqq maanne ke liye tayyar nahin hain

verses.text_uthmani: وَيَوْمَ نَبْعَثُ مِن كُلِّ أُمَّةٍ شَهِيدًا ثُمَّ لَا يُؤْذَنُ لِلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ وَلَا هُمْ يُسْتَعْتَبُونَ

translations.text: The day will come when We raise up a witness from every community, when the disbelievers will not be allowed to make excuses or amends.

(Inhein kuch hosh bhi hai ke us roz kya banegi) jabke hum har ummat mein se ek gawaah khada karenge, phir kaafiron ko na hujjatein (excuses) pesh karne ka mauqa diya jayega na unse tawba o istagfar hi ka mutalba kiya jayega

verses.text_uthmani: وَإِذَا رَءَا ٱلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا۟ ٱلْعَذَابَ فَلَا يُخَفَّفُ عَنْهُمْ وَلَا هُمْ يُنظَرُونَ

translations.text: When the evildoers face punishment it will not be lightened for them nor will they be given any respite.
Zalim log jab ek dafa azaab dekh lenge to iske baad na unke azaab mein koi takhfif (lightened /halka) ki jayegi aur na unhein ek lamha bhar ki mohlat di jayegi

verses.text_uthmani: وَإِذَا رَءَا ٱلَّذِينَ أَشْرَكُوا۟ شُرَكَآءَهُمْ قَالُوا۟ رَبَّنَا هَـٰٓؤُلَآءِ شُرَكَآؤُنَا ٱلَّذِينَ كُنَّا نَدْعُوا۟ مِن دُونِكَ ۖ فَأَلْقَوْا۟ إِلَيْهِمُ ٱلْقَوْلَ إِنَّكُمْ لَكَـٰذِبُونَ

translations.text: When the idolaters see the partners they joined with God they will say, ‘Our Lord, these are the partners we used to invoke beside You,’ but the partners will retort, ‘You are liars,’

Aur jab woh log jinhon ne duniya mein shirk kiya tha apne thehraye huey shareekon ko dekhenge to kahenge “ aey parwardigar, yahi hain hamare woh shareek jinhein hum tujhey chodh kar pukara karte thay” ispar unke woh mabood unhein saaf jawab denge ke “tum jhootey ho”

verses.text_uthmani: وَأَلْقَوْا۟ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ يَوْمَئِذٍ ٱلسَّلَمَ ۖ وَضَلَّ عَنْهُم مَّا كَانُوا۟ يَفْتَرُونَ

translations.text: and on that Day they will offer total submission to God: their false deities will desert them.
Us waqt yeh sab Allah ke aagey jhuk jaayenge aur unki woh saari iftara-pardaziyan(forgery) rafu-chakkar (vanish) ho jayengi jo yeh duniya mein karte rahey thay

verses.text_uthmani: ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ وَصَدُّوا۟ عَن سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ زِدْنَـٰهُمْ عَذَابًا فَوْقَ ٱلْعَذَابِ بِمَا كَانُوا۟ يُفْسِدُونَ

translations.text: Because of the corruption they spread, We shall add torment upon torment for those who disbelieved and barred others from the path of God.
Jin logon ne khud kufr ki raah ikhtiyar ki aur dusron ko Allah ki raah se roka unhein hum azaab par azaab denge us fasaad ke badle jo woh duniya mein barpa karte rahey

verses.text_uthmani: وَيَوْمَ نَبْعَثُ فِى كُلِّ أُمَّةٍ شَهِيدًا عَلَيْهِم مِّنْ أَنفُسِهِمْ ۖ وَجِئْنَا بِكَ شَهِيدًا عَلَىٰ هَـٰٓؤُلَآءِ ۚ وَنَزَّلْنَا عَلَيْكَ ٱلْكِتَـٰبَ تِبْيَـٰنًا لِّكُلِّ شَىْءٍ وَهُدًى وَرَحْمَةً وَبُشْرَىٰ لِلْمُسْلِمِينَ

translations.text: The day will come when We raise up in each community a witness against them, and We shall bring you [Prophet] as a witness against these people, for We have sent the Scripture down to you explaining everything, and as guidance and mercy and good news to those who devote themselves to God.

(Aey Muhammad, inhein us din se khabardar kardo) jabke hum har ummat mein khud usi ke andar se ek gawaah utha khada karenge jo uske muqable mein shahadat (witness/gawahi) dega. Aur in logon ke muqable mein shahadat dene ke liye hum tumhein layenge aur (yeh usi shadat ki tayyari hai ke) humne yeh kitab tumpar nazil kardi hai jo har cheez ki saaf saaf wazahat karne wali hai aur hidayat o rehmat aur basharat hai un logon ke liye jinhon ne sar-e-tasleem kham kar diya hai

verses.text_uthmani: ۞ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَأْمُرُ بِٱلْعَدْلِ وَٱلْإِحْسَـٰنِ وَإِيتَآئِ ذِى ٱلْقُرْبَىٰ وَيَنْهَىٰ عَنِ ٱلْفَحْشَآءِ وَٱلْمُنكَرِ وَٱلْبَغْىِ ۚ يَعِظُكُمْ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَذَكَّرُونَ

translations.text: God commands justice, doing good, and generosity towards relatives and He forbids what is shameful, blameworthy, and oppressive. He teaches you, so that you may take heed.
Allah adal (justice) aur ehsaan (generosity) aur sila rehmi ka hukum deta hai aur badhi(wickedness) o behayai aur zulm o zyadati se mana karta hai. Woh tumhein naseehat karta hai taa-ke tum sabaq lo

verses.text_uthmani: وَأَوْفُوا۟ بِعَهْدِ ٱللَّهِ إِذَا عَـٰهَدتُّمْ وَلَا تَنقُضُوا۟ ٱلْأَيْمَـٰنَ بَعْدَ تَوْكِيدِهَا وَقَدْ جَعَلْتُمُ ٱللَّهَ عَلَيْكُمْ كَفِيلًا ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَعْلَمُ مَا تَفْعَلُونَ

translations.text: Fulfil any pledge you make in God’s name and do not break oaths after you have sworn them, for you have made God your surety: God knows everything you do.

Allah ke ahad (covenant) ko poora karo jabke tumne ussey koi ahad bandha ho, aur apni kasmein pukhta karne ke baad todh na daalo jabke tum Allah ko apne upar gawah bana chuke ho. Allah tumhare sab afaal se bakhabar hai

verses.text_uthmani: وَلَا تَكُونُوا۟ كَٱلَّتِى نَقَضَتْ غَزْلَهَا مِنۢ بَعْدِ قُوَّةٍ أَنكَـٰثًا تَتَّخِذُونَ أَيْمَـٰنَكُمْ دَخَلًۢا بَيْنَكُمْ أَن تَكُونَ أُمَّةٌ هِىَ أَرْبَىٰ مِنْ أُمَّةٍ ۚ إِنَّمَا يَبْلُوكُمُ ٱللَّهُ بِهِۦ ۚ وَلَيُبَيِّنَنَّ لَكُمْ يَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَـٰمَةِ مَا كُنتُمْ فِيهِ تَخْتَلِفُونَ

translations.text: Do not use your oaths to deceive each other- like a woman who unravels the thread she has firmly spun- just because one party may be more numerous than another. God tests you with this, and on the Day of the Resurrection He will make clear to you those things you differed about.

Tumhari halat us aurat ki si na ho jaye jisne aap hi mehnat se soot kaata (spun yarn) aur phir aap hi usey tukde tukde kar dala. Tum apni kasamo ko aapas ke maamlaat mein makar o fareb ka hathiyar banate ho taa-ke ek qaum dusri qaum se badhkar faiyde hasil karey halaanke Allah is ahad o paimaan ke zariye se tumko aazmaish mein daalta hai. Aur zaroor woh qayamat ke roz tumhare tamaam ikhtilafaat ki haqeeqat tumpar khol dega

verses.text_uthmani: وَلَوْ شَآءَ ٱللَّهُ لَجَعَلَكُمْ أُمَّةً وَٰحِدَةً وَلَـٰكِن يُضِلُّ مَن يَشَآءُ وَيَهْدِى مَن يَشَآءُ ۚ وَلَتُسْـَٔلُنَّ عَمَّا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ

translations.text: If God so willed, He would have made you all one people, but He leaves to stray whoever He will and guides whoever He will. You will be questioned about your deeds.

Agar Allah ki mashiyat yeh hoti (ke tum mein koi ikhtilaf na ho) to woh tum sabko ek hi ummat bana deta, magar woh jisey chahta hai gumraahi mein daalta hai aur jisey chahta hain raah e raast dikha deta hai. Aur zaroor tumse tumhare aamaal ki baaz-purs hokar rahegi

verses.text_uthmani: وَلَا تَتَّخِذُوٓا۟ أَيْمَـٰنَكُمْ دَخَلًۢا بَيْنَكُمْ فَتَزِلَّ قَدَمٌۢ بَعْدَ ثُبُوتِهَا وَتَذُوقُوا۟ ٱلسُّوٓءَ بِمَا صَدَدتُّمْ عَن سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ ۖ وَلَكُمْ عَذَابٌ عَظِيمٌ

translations.text: Do not use your oaths to deceive each other lest any foot should slip after being firmly placed and lest you should taste the penalty for having hindered others from the path of God, and suffer terrible torment.

(aur Aey Musalmaano) tum apni kasamon ko aapas mein ek dusre ko dhoka dene ka zariya na bana lena, kahin aisa na ho ke koi qadam jamne ke baad ukhad jaye aur tum is jurm ki padash mein ke tumne logon ko Allah ki raah se roka, bura nateeja dekho aur sakht saza bhugto

verses.text_uthmani: وَلَا تَشْتَرُوا۟ بِعَهْدِ ٱللَّهِ ثَمَنًا قَلِيلًا ۚ إِنَّمَا عِندَ ٱللَّهِ هُوَ خَيْرٌ لَّكُمْ إِن كُنتُمْ تَعْلَمُونَ

translations.text: Do not sell for a small price any pledge made in God’s name: what God has [to give] is better for you, if you only knew.
Allah ke ahad ko thode se faiyde ke badle na bech daalo (sell off/barter away), jo kuch Allah ke paas hai woh tumhare liye zyada behtar hai agar tum jaano

verses.text_uthmani: مَا عِندَكُمْ يَنفَدُ ۖ وَمَا عِندَ ٱللَّهِ بَاقٍ ۗ وَلَنَجْزِيَنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ صَبَرُوٓا۟ أَجْرَهُم بِأَحْسَنِ مَا كَانُوا۟ يَعْمَلُونَ

translations.text: What you have runs out but what God has endures, and We shall certainly reward those who remain steadfast according to the best of their actions.

Jo kuch tumhare paas hai woh kharch ho janey wala hai aur jo kuch Allah ke paas hai wahi baaqi rehne wala hai, aur hum zaroor sabr se kaam lene walon ko unke ajar unke behtareen aamaal ke mutaabiq denge

verses.text_uthmani: مَنْ عَمِلَ صَـٰلِحًا مِّن ذَكَرٍ أَوْ أُنثَىٰ وَهُوَ مُؤْمِنٌ فَلَنُحْيِيَنَّهُۥ حَيَوٰةً طَيِّبَةً ۖ وَلَنَجْزِيَنَّهُمْ أَجْرَهُم بِأَحْسَنِ مَا كَانُوا۟ يَعْمَلُونَ

translations.text: To whoever, male or female, does good deeds and has faith, We shall give a good life and reward them according to the best of their actions.

Jo shaks bhi neik amal karega, khwa woh mard ho ya aurat, bashart ye ke ho woh momin, usey hum duniya mein pakeeza zindagi basar karayenge aur (aakhirat mein) aisey logon ko unke ajar unke behtareen aamaal ke mutabiq bakshenge

verses.text_uthmani: فَإِذَا قَرَأْتَ ٱلْقُرْءَانَ فَٱسْتَعِذْ بِٱللَّهِ مِنَ ٱلشَّيْطَـٰنِ ٱلرَّجِيمِ

translations.text: [Prophet], when you recite the Quran, seek God’s protection from the outcast, Satan.
Phir jab tum Quran padhne lago to Shaytan e rajeem (accursed) se khuda ki panaah maang liya karo

verses.text_uthmani: إِنَّهُۥ لَيْسَ لَهُۥ سُلْطَـٰنٌ عَلَى ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَلَىٰ رَبِّهِمْ يَتَوَكَّلُونَ

translations.text: He has no power over those who believe and trust in their Lord;
Usey un logon par tasallut (power/authority) hasil nahin hota jo iman latey aur apne Rubb par bharosa karte hain

verses.text_uthmani: إِنَّمَا سُلْطَـٰنُهُۥ عَلَى ٱلَّذِينَ يَتَوَلَّوْنَهُۥ وَٱلَّذِينَ هُم بِهِۦ مُشْرِكُونَ

translations.text: his power is only over those who ally themselves with him and those who, because of him, join partners with God.
Uska zoar to unhi logon par chalta hai jo usko apna sarparast banate aur uske behkane se shirk karte hain

verses.text_uthmani: وَإِذَا بَدَّلْنَآ ءَايَةً مَّكَانَ ءَايَةٍ ۙ وَٱللَّهُ أَعْلَمُ بِمَا يُنَزِّلُ قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّمَآ أَنتَ مُفْتَرٍۭ ۚ بَلْ أَكْثَرُهُمْ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ

translations.text: When We substitute one revelation for another- and God knows best what He reveals- they say, ‘You are just making it up,’ but most of them have no knowledge.

Jab hum ek ayat ki jagah dusri aayat nazil karte hain Allah behtar jaanta hia ke woh kya nazil karey to yeh log kehte hain ke tum yeh Quran khud ghadte ho. Asal baat yeh hai ke in mein se aksar log haqeeqat se na-waqif hain

verses.text_uthmani: قُلْ نَزَّلَهُۥ رُوحُ ٱلْقُدُسِ مِن رَّبِّكَ بِٱلْحَقِّ لِيُثَبِّتَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَهُدًى وَبُشْرَىٰ لِلْمُسْلِمِينَ

translations.text: Say that the Holy Spirit has brought the Revelation with the Truth step by step from your Lord, to strengthen the believers and as guidance and good news to the devout.

Insey kaho ke isey to rooh-ul-quddus ne theek theek mere Rubb ki taraf se ba-tadreej nazil kiya hai taa-ke iman laney walon ke iman ko pukhta karey aur farma-bardaron ko zindagi ke maamlaat mein seedhi raah bataye aur unhein falaah o saadat ki khush khabri de

verses.text_uthmani: وَلَقَدْ نَعْلَمُ أَنَّهُمْ يَقُولُونَ إِنَّمَا يُعَلِّمُهُۥ بَشَرٌ ۗ لِّسَانُ ٱلَّذِى يُلْحِدُونَ إِلَيْهِ أَعْجَمِىٌّ وَهَـٰذَا لِسَانٌ عَرَبِىٌّ مُّبِينٌ

translations.text: We know very well that they say, ‘It is a man who teaches him,’ but the language of the person they allude to is foreign, while this revelation is in clear Arabic.
Humein maloom hai yeh log tumhare mutaaliq kehte hain ke is shaks ko ek aadmi sikhata padhata hai. Halaanke unka ishara jis aadmi ki taraf hai uski zubaan ajami hai aur yeh saaf arabi zubaan hai

verses.text_uthmani: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ بِـَٔايَـٰتِ ٱللَّهِ لَا يَهْدِيهِمُ ٱللَّهُ وَلَهُمْ عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌ

translations.text: If people do not believe in God’s revelation, God does not guide them, and a painful punishment awaits them.
Haqeeqat yeh hai ke jo log Allah ki aayat ko nahin maante Allah kabhi unko saheeh baat tak pahunchne ki taufeeq nahin deta aur aise logon ke liye dardnaak azaab hai

verses.text_uthmani: إِنَّمَا يَفْتَرِى ٱلْكَذِبَ ٱلَّذِينَ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ بِـَٔايَـٰتِ ٱللَّهِ ۖ وَأُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلْكَـٰذِبُونَ

translations.text: Falsehood is fabricated only by those who do not believe in God’s revelation: they are the liars.
(Jhooti baatein Nabi nahin ghadta balke) jhoot woh log ghad rahey hain jo Allah ki aayat ko nahin maante, wahi haqeeqat mein jhootey hain

verses.text_uthmani: مَن كَفَرَ بِٱللَّهِ مِنۢ بَعْدِ إِيمَـٰنِهِۦٓ إِلَّا مَنْ أُكْرِهَ وَقَلْبُهُۥ مُطْمَئِنٌّۢ بِٱلْإِيمَـٰنِ وَلَـٰكِن مَّن شَرَحَ بِٱلْكُفْرِ صَدْرًا فَعَلَيْهِمْ غَضَبٌ مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ وَلَهُمْ عَذَابٌ عَظِيمٌ

translations.text: With the exception of those who are forced to say they do not believe, although their hearts remain firm in faith, those who reject God after believing in Him and open their hearts to disbelief will have the wrath of God upon them and a grievous punishment awaiting them.

Jo shaks iman laney ke baad kufr karey (woh agar) majboor kiya gaya ho aur dil uska iman par mutmaeen (convinced) ho (tab to khair) magar jisne dil ki raza-mandi se kufr ko qabool karliya uspar Allah ka gazab hai aur aisey sab logon ke liye bada azaab hai

verses.text_uthmani: ذَٰلِكَ بِأَنَّهُمُ ٱسْتَحَبُّوا۟ ٱلْحَيَوٰةَ ٱلدُّنْيَا عَلَى ٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ وَأَنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَا يَهْدِى ٱلْقَوْمَ ٱلْكَـٰفِرِينَ

translations.text: This is because they love the life of this world more than the one to come, and God does not guide those who reject Him.
Yeh isliye ke unhon ne aakhirat ke muqable mein duniya ki zindagi ko pasand karliya, aur Allah ka qaida hai ke woh un logon ko raah e nijaat nahin dikhata jo uski niyamat ka kufraan karein

verses.text_uthmani: أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ ٱلَّذِينَ طَبَعَ ٱللَّهُ عَلَىٰ قُلُوبِهِمْ وَسَمْعِهِمْ وَأَبْصَـٰرِهِمْ ۖ وَأُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلْغَـٰفِلُونَ

translations.text: These are people whose hearts, hearing, and sight have been closed off by God: they are heedless,
Yeh woh log hain jinke dilon aur kaano aur aankhon par Allah ne mohar (seal) laga di hai yeh gaflat mein doob chuke hain

verses.text_uthmani: لَا جَرَمَ أَنَّهُمْ فِى ٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ هُمُ ٱلْخَـٰسِرُونَ

translations.text: and there is no doubt that they will be the losers in the Hereafter.
Zaroor hai ke aakhirat mein yahi khasare mein rahein

verses.text_uthmani: ثُمَّ إِنَّ رَبَّكَ لِلَّذِينَ هَاجَرُوا۟ مِنۢ بَعْدِ مَا فُتِنُوا۟ ثُمَّ جَـٰهَدُوا۟ وَصَبَرُوٓا۟ إِنَّ رَبَّكَ مِنۢ بَعْدِهَا لَغَفُورٌ رَّحِيمٌ

translations.text: But your Lord will be most forgiving and most merciful to those who leave their homes after persecution, then strive and remain steadfast.

Ba-khilaf iske jin logon ka haal yeh hai ke jab (iman laney ki wajah se) woh sataye gaye to unhon ne ghar-baar chodh diye, hijrat ki, raah e khuda mein sakhtiyan jheli aur sabr se kaam liya, unke liye yaqeenan tera Rubb gafoor o raheem hai

verses.text_uthmani: ۞ يَوْمَ تَأْتِى كُلُّ نَفْسٍ تُجَـٰدِلُ عَن نَّفْسِهَا وَتُوَفَّىٰ كُلُّ نَفْسٍ مَّا عَمِلَتْ وَهُمْ لَا يُظْلَمُونَ

translations.text: On the Day when every soul will come pleading for itself, every soul will be paid in full for all its actions- they will not be wronged.
(In sab ka faisla us din hoga) jabke har mutanaffis apne hi bachao ki fikr mein laga hua hoga aur har ek ko uske kiye ka badla poora poora diya jayega aur kisi par zarra barabar zulm na hone payega

verses.text_uthmani: وَضَرَبَ ٱللَّهُ مَثَلًا قَرْيَةً كَانَتْ ءَامِنَةً مُّطْمَئِنَّةً يَأْتِيهَا رِزْقُهَا رَغَدًا مِّن كُلِّ مَكَانٍ فَكَفَرَتْ بِأَنْعُمِ ٱللَّهِ فَأَذَٰقَهَا ٱللَّهُ لِبَاسَ ٱلْجُوعِ وَٱلْخَوْفِ بِمَا كَانُوا۟ يَصْنَعُونَ

translations.text: God presents the example of a town that was secure and at ease, with provisions coming to it abundantly from all places. Then it became ungrateful for God’s blessings, so God afflicted it with the garment of famine and fear, for what its people had done.

Allah ek basti ki misal deta hai , woh aman o itminaan ki zindagi basar kar rahi thi aur har taraf se usko ba-faragat rizq pahunch raha tha ke usne Allah ki niyamaton ka kufraan shuru kardiya , tab Allah ne uske bashindon ko unke kartooton ka yeh maza chakkhaya ke bhook aur khauf ki museebatein unpar chaa gayi

verses.text_uthmani: وَلَقَدْ جَآءَهُمْ رَسُولٌ مِّنْهُمْ فَكَذَّبُوهُ فَأَخَذَهُمُ ٱلْعَذَابُ وَهُمْ ظَـٰلِمُونَ

translations.text: A messenger who was one of them came to them, but they called him a liar. So punishment overwhelmed them in the midst of their evildoing.
Unke paas unki apni qaum mein se ek Rasool aaya magar unhon ne usko jhutla diya, aakhir e kaar azaab ne unko aa liya jabke woh zalim ho chuke thay

verses.text_uthmani: فَكُلُوا۟ مِمَّا رَزَقَكُمُ ٱللَّهُ حَلَـٰلًا طَيِّبًا وَٱشْكُرُوا۟ نِعْمَتَ ٱللَّهِ إِن كُنتُمْ إِيَّاهُ تَعْبُدُونَ

translations.text: So eat of the good and lawful things God has provided for you and be thankful for His blessings, if it is Him that you worship.
Pas aey logon, Allah ne jo kuch halal aur paak rizq tumko bakhsa hai usey khao aur Allah ke ehsaan ka shukar ada karo agar tum waqayi usi ki bandagi karne waley ho

verses.text_uthmani: إِنَّمَا حَرَّمَ عَلَيْكُمُ ٱلْمَيْتَةَ وَٱلدَّمَ وَلَحْمَ ٱلْخِنزِيرِ وَمَآ أُهِلَّ لِغَيْرِ ٱللَّهِ بِهِۦ ۖ فَمَنِ ٱضْطُرَّ غَيْرَ بَاغٍ وَلَا عَادٍ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ غَفُورٌ رَّحِيمٌ

translations.text: He has forbidden you only these things: carrion, blood, pig’s meat, and animals over which any name other than God’s has been invoked. But if anyone is forced by hunger, not desiring it nor exceeding their immediate need, God is forgiving and merciful.

Allah ne jo kuch tumpar haram kiya hai woh hai murdaar aur khoon aur suwar (khinzir/swine) ka gosht aur woh jaanwar jispar Allah ke siwa kisi aur ka naam liya gaya ho. Albatta bhook se majboor hokar agar koi in cheezon ko kha ley, bagair iske ke woh kanoon e ilahi ki khilaf warzi ka khwahish-mand ho, ya hadd e zaroorat se tajawuz ka murtakib ho, to yaqeenan Allah maaf karne aur reham farmane wala hai

verses.text_uthmani: وَلَا تَقُولُوا۟ لِمَا تَصِفُ أَلْسِنَتُكُمُ ٱلْكَذِبَ هَـٰذَا حَلَـٰلٌ وَهَـٰذَا حَرَامٌ لِّتَفْتَرُوا۟ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ ٱلْكَذِبَ ۚ إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ يَفْتَرُونَ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ ٱلْكَذِبَ لَا يُفْلِحُونَ

translations.text: Do not say falsely, ‘This is lawful and that is forbidden,’ inventing a lie about God: those who invent lies about God will not prosper-

Aur yeh jo tumhari zubaanein jhoote ehkaam lagaya karti hain ke yeh cheez halal hai aur woh haram, to is tarah ke hukum laga kar Allah par jhoot na baandha karo, jo log Allah par jhoote iftara bandhte (ascribe lies) hain woh hargiz falaah nahin paya karte

verses.text_uthmani: مَتَـٰعٌ قَلِيلٌ وَلَهُمْ عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌ

translations.text: they may have a little enjoyment, but painful punishment awaits them.
Duniya ka aish chandh roza hai aakhir e kaar unke liye dardnaak saza hai

verses.text_uthmani: وَعَلَى ٱلَّذِينَ هَادُوا۟ حَرَّمْنَا مَا قَصَصْنَا عَلَيْكَ مِن قَبْلُ ۖ وَمَا ظَلَمْنَـٰهُمْ وَلَـٰكِن كَانُوٓا۟ أَنفُسَهُمْ يَظْلِمُونَ

translations.text: [Prophet], We forbade the Jews what We told you about. We did not wrong them; they wronged themselves.

Woh cheezein humne khaas taur par yahudiyon (jews) ke liye haram ki thi jinka zikr hum issey pehle tumse kar chuke hain aur yeh unpar hamara zulm na tha balke unka apna hi zulm tha jo woh apne upar kar rahey thay

verses.text_uthmani: ثُمَّ إِنَّ رَبَّكَ لِلَّذِينَ عَمِلُوا۟ ٱلسُّوٓءَ بِجَهَـٰلَةٍ ثُمَّ تَابُوا۟ مِنۢ بَعْدِ ذَٰلِكَ وَأَصْلَحُوٓا۟ إِنَّ رَبَّكَ مِنۢ بَعْدِهَا لَغَفُورٌ رَّحِيمٌ

translations.text: But towards those who do wrong out of ignorance, and afterwards repent and make amends, your Lord is most forgiving and merciful.
Albatta jin logon ne jahalat ki bina par bura amal kiya aur phir tawba karke apne amal ki islah karli to yaqeenan tawba o islaah ke baad tera Rubb unke liye gafoor aur raheem hai

verses.text_uthmani: إِنَّ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ كَانَ أُمَّةً قَانِتًا لِّلَّهِ حَنِيفًا وَلَمْ يَكُ مِنَ ٱلْمُشْرِكِينَ

translations.text: Abraham was truly an example: devoutly obedient to God and true in faith. He was not an idolater;
Waqiya yeh hai ke Ibrahim apni zaat se ek puri ummat tha, Allah ka muti e farman aur yaksu. Woh kabhi mushrik na tha

verses.text_uthmani: شَاكِرًا لِّأَنْعُمِهِ ۚ ٱجْتَبَىٰهُ وَهَدَىٰهُ إِلَىٰ صِرَٰطٍ مُّسْتَقِيمٍ

translations.text: he was thankful for the blessings of God who chose him and guided him to a straight path.
Allah ki niyamaton ka shukar ada karne wala tha. Allah ne usko muntakhab (chose) karliya aur seedha raasta dikhaya

verses.text_uthmani: وَءَاتَيْنَـٰهُ فِى ٱلدُّنْيَا حَسَنَةً ۖ وَإِنَّهُۥ فِى ٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ لَمِنَ ٱلصَّـٰلِحِينَ

translations.text: We gave him blessings in this world, and he is among the right-eous in the Hereafter.
Duniya mein usko bhalayi di aur aakhirat mein woh yaqeenan saliheen mein se hoga

verses.text_uthmani: ثُمَّ أَوْحَيْنَآ إِلَيْكَ أَنِ ٱتَّبِعْ مِلَّةَ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ حَنِيفًا ۖ وَمَا كَانَ مِنَ ٱلْمُشْرِكِينَ

translations.text: Then We revealed to you [Muhammad], ‘Follow the creed of Abraham, a man of pure faith who was not an idolater.’
Phir humne tumhari taraf yeh wahee bheji ke yaksu hokar Ibrahim ke tareeqe par chalo aur woh mushrikon mein se na tha

verses.text_uthmani: إِنَّمَا جُعِلَ ٱلسَّبْتُ عَلَى ٱلَّذِينَ ٱخْتَلَفُوا۟ فِيهِ ۚ وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَيَحْكُمُ بَيْنَهُمْ يَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَـٰمَةِ فِيمَا كَانُوا۟ فِيهِ يَخْتَلِفُونَ

translations.text: The Sabbath was made obligatory only for those who differed about it. On the Day of Resurrection your Lord will judge between them as to their differences.

Raha sabt (Sabbath/ hafte ka din) to woh humne un logon par musallat kiya tha jinhon ne uske ehkaam mein ikhtilaf kiya, aur yaqeenan tera Rubb qayamat ke roz un sab baaton ka faisla kardega jin mein woh ikhtilaf karte rahey hain

verses.text_uthmani: ٱدْعُ إِلَىٰ سَبِيلِ رَبِّكَ بِٱلْحِكْمَةِ وَٱلْمَوْعِظَةِ ٱلْحَسَنَةِ ۖ وَجَـٰدِلْهُم بِٱلَّتِى هِىَ أَحْسَنُ ۚ إِنَّ رَبَّكَ هُوَ أَعْلَمُ بِمَن ضَلَّ عَن سَبِيلِهِۦ ۖ وَهُوَ أَعْلَمُ بِٱلْمُهْتَدِينَ

translations.text: [Prophet], call [people] to the way of your Lord with wisdom and good teaching. Argue with them in the most courteous way, for your Lord knows best who has strayed from His way and who is rightly guided.

(Aey Nabi), apne Rubb ke raaste ki taraf dawat do hikmat aur umdah naseehat ke saath, aur logon se mubahisa(discuss) karo aise tareeqe par jo behtareen ho. Tumhara Rubb hi zyada behtar jaanta hai ke kaun uski raah se bhatka hua hai aur kaun raah-e-raast par hai

verses.text_uthmani: وَإِنْ عَاقَبْتُمْ فَعَاقِبُوا۟ بِمِثْلِ مَا عُوقِبْتُم بِهِۦ ۖ وَلَئِن صَبَرْتُمْ لَهُوَ خَيْرٌ لِّلصَّـٰبِرِينَ

translations.text: If you [believers] have to respond to an attack, make your response proportionate, but it is best to stand fast.
Aur agar tum log badla lo to bas usi qadar le lo jis qadar tumpar zyadati ki gayi ho, lekin agar tum sabr karo to yaqeenan yeh sabr karne walon hi ke haqq mein behtar hai

verses.text_uthmani: وَٱصْبِرْ وَمَا صَبْرُكَ إِلَّا بِٱللَّهِ ۚ وَلَا تَحْزَنْ عَلَيْهِمْ وَلَا تَكُ فِى ضَيْقٍ مِّمَّا يَمْكُرُونَ

translations.text: So [Prophet] be steadfast: your steadfastness comes only from God. Do not grieve over them; do not be distressed by their scheming,
(Aey Muhammad) sabr se kaam kiye jao aur tumhara yeh sabr Allah hi ki toufeeq se hai, in logon ki harakat par ranjh na karo aur na inki chaalbaaziyon par dil tangg (distress) ho

verses.text_uthmani: إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ مَعَ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱتَّقَوا۟ وَّٱلَّذِينَ هُم مُّحْسِنُونَ

translations.text: for God is with those who are mindful of Him and who do good.
Allah un logon ke saath hai jo taqwa se kaam letay hain aur ehsan par amal karte hain
